resources.string: Send plugin credentials?
Use your phone’s plugin logins on %1$s. Choose which plugins to send, or skip this step.

Only send credentials on a secure network, even though Sync is end-to-end encrypted. Anyone using this TV may be able to access your accounts. Sending replaces the selected plugins’ existing logins on the TV.
Choose plugins
Select all
Clear all
To %1$s
Continue (%1$d)
Send credentials to %1$s

Sending credentials and waiting for the TV…
No plugin logins are saved on this phone. Sign in to a plugin on your phone first.
Not available on TV
The TV is not connected over Sync. Open Grayjay on the TV, enable Sync on both devices, and connect them to the same secure network.
This device does not support receiving plugin credentials. Update Grayjay on the TV and try again.
The TV did not respond. Make sure it is connected over Sync and running a version of Grayjay that supports receiving plugin credentials.
A selected plugin or its login changed. Choose the plugins again.
Could not send credentials. Check the Sync connection and try again.
The TV has not confirmed the transfer. Credentials may already have been saved. Check the TV before trying again.
These credentials are too large to transfer. Try sending fewer plugins.
Credential transfer

%1$s: saved; reopen Grayjay on the TV to use this login

Pair this TV over Sync before sending plugin credentials. Continue with the ADB setup below to install or update Grayjay and pair the TV.
Send selected plugin logins to this TV over Sync.
Keep Grayjay open on the TV and Sync enabled on both devices. Plugin credentials are sent only when you choose to send them.
